title: Research: four signed-connector shears must all point the same way
body:
## Result

For M=[[1,1,1],[1,1,-1],[1,-1,0]], exactly twelve ordinary signed Ai/Bj queries and four nonzero arbitrary Q/C scalar shears on two independent dirty roots admit **no mixed-direction transfer word**. Combined with credited PR1983/PR1651, the entire bidirectional four-pass class reduces to the two global one-way forced-unit/forced-port classes. Its complete additive tariff is the minimum of their two fully priced sums.

This closes PR1675’s explicit four-pass handoff. It does not claim a new four-pass minimum or construction: PR1675 excludes <=3; PR1651 attains4; PR1682 and PR1983 prove the unit and arbitrary-coefficient one-way results. Those predecessors remain unchanged and credited.

## Why this covers arbitrary coefficients

The symbolic root-only classification reduces every restoring mixed four-shear word, using centrality and cyclic rotation of the full endpoint, to U(a),U(-a),L(b),L(-b). Exact normalized source columns and dirty reader rows permit a port-changing pair only when a=b=+1 or a=b=-1. Outside those cases, cross-root coefficients vanish and connected target support reduces to the inherited one-root obstruction.

The exceptional cases reduce to one unit loop, with **all eight column-sign choices and both source/read port changes retained**. Chronological propagation and a separate phase-placement/open-interval checker agree on every full 27-bit reader mask for all69,948 canonical source traces /559,584 signed traces. There are7,020 canonical source-port-changing traces and zero target successes. An all-ones target has51,192 successes; explicit legal source-switch/read-switch pilots prevent an invalid reuse of the old same-port assumption.

## Evidence and reproduction

Only `research/bidirectional-four-shear-rigidity/` changes: complete proof, exact evidence, two checker models, meaningful semantic/binding controls, source pins, full chooser selection, TASK, VERIFY and exercised validation.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/bidirectional-four-shear-rigidity
```

Observed on CPython3.12.12/macOS arm64:
- `PASS_BIDIRECTIONAL_FOUR_SHEAR_RIGIDITY canonical_traces=69948 signed_traces=559584 mixed_successes=0 symbolic_shapes=16 no_new_kappa`
- `PASS_FOUR_SHEAR_PACKAGE_CONTROLS source_mutations=5 receipt_mutations=1 relocated_optimized=true read_only=true`
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`

The parent independently reviewed the reduction and replayed this registered package before publication. No hosted CI success is claimed.

## Scope, attribution and independent assignment

No physical supplier, new recursive moment/kappa, proof-assistant acceptance, selected cold replay, or new full child lowering is claimed. Scratch restoration is the complete-query interface premise. Both checker algorithms were written by the same AI assistant, not independent humans.

Credit Ross Richardson (PR944/943/934,1651,1682), Charles Bethin (PR1637,1983), Cinna Davis (PR1675), and their retained lineage. New work: Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Single independent seed `652b2d372ee11d8364eb3ba12820c34c`; recursive-interfaces / connector-alphabet-change; base `e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a`; no reroll. Claim: #research-claim-and-completion-record . Final overlap used complete343-open-PR/717-discussion shared snapshot plus targeted live/merged predecessors; no-match is not a novelty proof. PR2065’s F2 five-source/six-transfer result is distinct.

Full commit: `ac135d637e74dd11d44901bc91863f2990823e59`.

## Research claim and completion record

Status: completed. The claim record is preserved here so this PR is self-contained. Historical coordination links in the committed research metadata refer to this record; the separate coordination discussion is being removed.

Result: for signed M=[[1,1,1],[1,1,-1],[1,-1,0]], exactly12 ordinary signed Ai/Bj queries and4 nonzero arbitrary Q/C root shears admit no mixed-direction word. Thus the whole bidirectional four-pass class reduces to the two global one-way forced-unit/forced-port classes of credited PR1983/1651, and its additive tariff is the minimum of their two complete sums.

Critical reduction: all mixed restoring4shear loops are disjoint/nested inverse excursions; endpoint centrality permits rotation to U(a),U(-a),L(b),L(-b). Genuine port switches force a=b=±1. All other cases have zero cross-root coefficients and collapse to the inherited one-root obstruction. Both exact exceptional-case engines include source/read port changes and all8column-sign choices:69948canonical/559584signed traces,7020 source-switch traces,zero target successes;51192 all-ones positive-control successes. Full reader-mask maps agree, not merely totals.
